answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital as a quartz-like anchor to validate transitions. Instead of a low-cost orchard of fake identities, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens, a relic of early distribution, to influence consensus. This financial barrier ensures that controlling the network scales linearly with cost, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational and technically non-viable.
